content: {"like":["Packaging is nicely done and good quality","HD remastering provides 3x sharpness, accurate color, and depth","DTS-MA sound is full‑ranged and detailed","Fire Walk With Me transfer is excellent with natural film look","Missing Pieces are included in full HD with DTS sound","New extras such as Between Two Worlds, Atmospherics, and outtakes","Overall content far exceeds similar releases","The set feels like a dream release for Twin Peaks fans"],"dislike":["Packaging requires effort to flip through and access discs","No booklet listing disc contents, causing frustration","Some shots (e.g., early episodes, a long montage in season two) were not upgraded to HD and stand out","Missing extras due to licensing (Artisan season one commentaries, SNL skits, coffee commercials)"]}
